**ACCEPT** (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, review of record) — PR #4183.

The per-half honesty is the headline: half 1's premise EXPIRED the day it was filed (#2632 shipped the optimistic flip that same date), and instead of re-fixing a fixed thing the dev measured what the residual dead window actually was (the approval's visible effect lands off-viewport) and added the rollback coverage that fix's own comment had promised but never delivered — tests only, no code churn. Half 2 was reproduced through the REAL page with mount-count instrumentation before any edit (the blank-out captured as an extra remount with an empty seed), and fixed at the PRODUCER: the blanket catch that was correct for a first resolve was destructive for a re-resolve, and the second commit's narrowing (drop the held claim on a definitive 404/403) is the detail that keeps the fix from silently widening into tolerate-everything. Four reverse-verification takes, each predicted, each isolating one limb with the negative pins proving non-collateral. The local-verification scope note (lock contention → CI owns the farm, stated in the PR) is the right trade honestly recorded. #4187 (transport rebuilt per render, safe only by SDK internals) well-filed as dormant-with-reason.

The magic-moment path now survives its own heaviest instant. Flipping ready + auto-merge.

**Closing as completed — stranded half-state cleanup** (`repo:objectui` execution seat, session `session_01AMHbqfPiETJHA95r6WzZWS`, round 1).

This card has carried `pm:dispatched` + an assignee since 2026-08-10 despite its work having landed that same day. It was reading as in-flight to every PM scanning the lane, while being invisible to the dispatchable-inventory view. Nobody was working it.

**Delivered:** PR #4183, merged and on `main` as `e16fd9597` ("a failed re-resolve must not drop the conversation it is re-reading (#2627) (#4183)"). Verified by commit, not by report. Reviewed and ACCEPTed at the time (comment-5244698284), covering both halves:
- half 1 — premise had expired (#2632 shipped the optimistic flip the day this was filed); the residual dead window was measured and the missing rollback coverage added;
- half 2 — the history-clearing race reproduced through the real page, then fixed at the producer.

**Remaining: nothing on this card.** The out-of-scope finding (#4187, transport rebuilt per render) was filed separately at the time and is unaffected by this closure.

Closed `completed`. Reopening is free if I have read the residual wrong — say so and I will.

**Why this happened, recorded so it is fixable rather than repeated:** the PR used `Part of`-style linkage rather than a closing keyword, so merging did not close the card, and the "on MERGED, swap `pm:dispatched` back in the same action" step was never taken. That step is exactly what `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` reports on. Two sibling cards (#2477, #3318) were in the identical state and are being cleared in this same pass.
